unit.why: Within a teaching on distress of mind (חלישות דעת), the Komarna author tells a first-person memorate of visiting R. Naftali of Ropshitz, their exchange, and the tsaddik's homily on Hezekiah and Isaiah.
unit.boundary_note: division is section ב) of the topic 'מענין חלישות דעת' begun in the previous division; the story is framed by homiletic teaching

stories.start_quote: ובעת שעליתי לקבל אנפי שכינתא לקבל
stories.summary_en: The author visits R. Naftali of Ropshitz, who asks why his face shines despite persecution; the author says opponents' chatter cannot touch him, and the tsaddik answers with a kabbalistic homily on the dispute of Hezekiah and Isaiah: Heaven greatly fears causing distress of mind, and the author replies that God widens his mind with the light of the world to come.
